title: T54 (Tinyana) PNC - Bechirah for the Israelite — Avodah in Every Single Thing
author: Pettek Nanach

beginner.en: Bechirah is in the hand of a person to do as he wishes — and even more, all things are in the hand of the Israelite person to conduct everything as he wishes, as his bechirah. For with Yisrael there is bechirah be-yadam over every single thing in the world. Among others there are matters in which they are mukhrachim, compelled. But by an Israelite, every single thing he does — even traveling somewhere or the like — has avodah in it; therefore he has bechirah over all.

intermediate.en: **Ha-bechirah be-yad ha-adam la'asos ki-rtzono.** Va-afilu kol ha-devarim — **ha-kol be-yad ha-ish ha-Yisre'eli le-his-naheg ha-kol ki-rtzono ki-vchiraso**. Ki **be-yad Yisrael yesh bechirah be-yadam al kol davar she-ba-olam**. Ki etzel acherim yesh devarim she-hem mukhrachim ba-hem, aval **etzel ish ha-Yisre'eli — kol davar va-davar she-hu oseh** (kegon li-nso'a le-eizeh makom ve-cha-yotzei) — **yesh bo avodah, ve-al-ken yesh lo bechirah al ha-kol.**

scholarly.he: [T2:54] בחירה לישראל בכל דבר. הבדל בין ישראל לאומות העולם — אצלם מוכרחים, אצלנו עבודה ובחירה. עי' לק"מ ח"א רס"א (בחירה); ח"ב ז' (איש ישראלי).
